The search frame needs reshaping. The confirmed product map has five top-level regions, not eight:

**Heart of the product (two innovations):**
- Library — company knowledge made atomic and accessible to agents.
- Playbook — work processes made atomic and accessible to agents.

**Three enabling systems at the same level:**
- Viewer (was "Product Shell") — makes the system real and usable to a human director.
- Ledger — coordination and QA; the record of what has happened.
- Triggers (was "Session Wake") — activates and coordinates colleagues within the organization.

**Removed from the product map:**
- Vision Onboarding — not a product region; it is one play among what will be thousands. It is built out because it tested play capabilities.
- Knowledge Production — prototyping work in progress, not a shipped product region yet. The current exercise (this library build) is the first real knowledge-production work.

**To sort out separately:**
- Canvas — the director is unclear what the scan pulled. At least two meanings exist: the main viewer as an interactive canvas, and a very recent QA canvas concept. Needs its own conversation.

**Naming correction:**
- "Session Wake" is renamed to "Triggers" as the product name for the system that fires plays or moves within plays.
